text: Rajab First Duas.org       Rajab First Aamal for the First Eve/Day of Rajab Month Rajab Month index Significance Significance × Referring to the recommended rites at the first night of Rajab, Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned, in his book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid, that Abuâl-Bukhtari Wahab ibn Wahab has narrated on the authority of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) on the authority of his father on the authority of his grandfather (peace be upon them all) who said that Imam `Ali (peace be upon him) used to devote himself to acts of worship in an exclusive way at four nights, (1) the first night of Rajab, (2) the middle night (i.e. fifteen) of Sha`ban, (3) the `id al-Fitr Night (i.e. the first night of Shawwal), and (4) the Nahr Night (the tenth of Dhuâl-hijjah). Section 2 On the Nobility of the First Night of the Month of Rajab It was said before that narrations and the deeds of the Shiah agree on the point that the first night of the month of Rajab is one of the four nights to stay up and perform acts of worship and turn to God who is aware of all hidden things. One of the characterisitcs of this night is that when man comes out of the month of Muharram he has left the protection which the Almighty God has allocated to the sacred months. Thus, the especial protection has been taken away from him. Thus, when the first night of the month of Rajab arrives, he is again covered by Divine Protection that he had left. The difference between leaving the protection of the rulers and separating from the safety they provide when we fear their blaming or punishment and being honored with the high rank of experiencing Divine Reward is not hidden from the wise people ! Thus, on the first night of the month of Rajab one must confess to this endless Favor of the Almighty God and firmly grab onto this stronghold. Thus you should turn to God and ask him to improve your affairs. Consider yourself to be in the presence of the Lord and a guest of the Prophet (as).
